title: FastFeller
description: An easy tree chopping Minecraft plugin for Paper, inspired by Hytale
body:
# FastFeller

A Minecraft plugin for Paper servers that allows trees to be chopped fast with the whole tree breaking when all supporting logs are broken, eliminating the need to break each individual block, inspired by Hytale.

## Permissions

- `fastfeller.use` - Allows players to easily chop trees.

## Issues

If you encounter any bugs or would like a new feature added, please open an [issue](https://github.com/SulkyWhale/FastFeller/issues/new). Be sure to check existing issues first to avoid duplicates.

## Contributing

Contributions are welcome. If you have any bug fixes, improvements, or new features you would like to add to this project, feel free to open a [pull request](https://github.com/SulkyWhale/FastFeller/pulls).
